scientific_integrity: The uniform state-frequency proof and complete 128-state/residue finite reduction are in RESULT.md. verify.py independently reconstructs every small-factor case. Independent external audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is confined to the binary parity-of-adjacent-11 Rudin–Shapiro word; a length cutoff was known previously, and an unindexed equivalent result is possible. Finite tests do not independently establish the infinite theorem.
title: Equal occurrence frequencies for every palindrome in the Rudin–Shapiro word
